cells.gaps: No framework is on record as being written: the May 2024 notice only sought a consultant, with no drafting begun, and no later source is held.
cells.note: The notice seeks a consultant to write the framework and says no drafting had begun, which the study does not count as a framework being written (as with Liberia and Cape Verde). It is not a dated statement that none exists either, so no rung is set.
